defect_summary: First WRITE_NOTES wrote empty Highlights (placeholder) and the notes gate immediately refused RELEASE_NOTES:NOT_MET.
unsuitable_process: build_draft emits HIGHLIGHTS_PLACEHOLDER, which check_notes is written to reject. WRITE_NOTES is a REPAIR whose progress fact is notes_valid; a known-invalid draft cannot move that fact. ADR 0049: Highlights are human-only; that decision must precede the write.
climb_steps: check_notes failed Highlights section is empty / placeholder.
build_draft wrote the placeholder it then rejects.
WRITE_NOTES cannot set notes_valid with those bytes.
ADR 0049 repair must change its progress fact; Highlights are HUMAN_DECISION.

repo_touch.belief: ADR 0025 — defects name unsuitable process, not agents
